title: UMBRELLA: Mix and audio: the Mix workspace, its fader, reference-aware delete, a song model
description: Four loose todo cards that are one audio system, all post-2.0. Grouped by the umbrella sweep 2026-09-29, approved by Fabio. Members: MPI-917 (Mix workspace), MPI-740 (MpiFader wheel, the mixer's fader), MPI-920 (delete warns when a card is used by reference, e.g. by a Mix). MPI-775 (YuE2 song model) moved to MPI-1179 (New Models to Test), 2026-10-18. Phases and parallel batches in plan.md.
